title: Simulation + NC Parameter Catalog — VIRTUAL Machining, Post Configs ~500 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas for VIRTUAL Machining simulation (~250 params) and NC output/post-processor configuration (~250 params). Simulation covers machine selection/kinematic configuration, collision simulation settings, stock verification tolerances, travel limit definitions, cycle time estimation, NC verification replay, nightSHIFT batch settings, and report configuration. NC output covers calculation options, post-processor selection and configuration, output folder/naming conventions, batch processing, PPP enhancement settings, and delivery/DNC configuration.

reference: hyperMILL training manuals (VIRTUAL Machining, NC output sections)

forge_triple.hook: simulationCollisionBlocker — BUILT — HARD BLOCK on collision detection in simulation
forge_triple.action: generate_simulation_nc_catalog — BUILT — generates simulation + NC artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-simulation-params — BUILT — simulation and NC output parameter reference

sessions.title: VIRTUAL Machining Simulation Parameter Schemas (~250 params)
knowledge: Machine selection and kinematic model configuration
Collision simulation: full sim, quick check, per-operation, per-block
Stock verification: material removal, rest material, gouge detection
Travel limits: axis travel, rotary limits, singularity zones
nightSHIFT batch settings: max_parallel, priority, notification
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for all VIRTUAL Machining simulation parameters. Collision simulation gets HARD BLOCK hooks — any collision detected must prevent NC output. Stock verification hooks flag gouge and excess material. Travel limit hooks validate axis positions against machine kinematic model.

units.title: Machine Config + Collision + Stock Verification Schemas — ~160 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for machine selection (load kinematic model, configure axes, set limits — 3 command types), collision simulation (full sim, quick check, per-operation, per-block — 4 types with tolerance, collision_distance, check_scope settings), stock verification (material removal tolerance, rest material threshold, gouge detection sensitivity — 3 types), and travel limits (axis travel min/max, rotary limits, singularity zones — 3 types). HARD BLOCK collision hook prevents NC output when collision detected.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Machine config schemas: >= 30 parameters with kinematic model validation
Collision simulation schemas: >= 40 parameters with HARD BLOCK on collision
Stock verification schemas: >= 30 parameters with gouge detection
Travel limit schemas: >= 30 parameters with axis limit validation from MachineRegistry
Collision HARD BLOCK hook prevents NC generation when collision detected
Unit tests for collision tolerance range and travel limit boundary checks

units.title: Cycle Time + NC Verify + nightSHIFT + Report Schemas — ~90 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for cycle time estimation (estimate per operation, total, compare — 3 types), NC verification (code replay, block-by-block, spindle load — 4 types with feed/speed limit validation), nightSHIFT batch (batch calculate, batch simulate, batch post — 3 types with max_parallel, priority, notification), and report configuration (collision report, cycle time report, verification log — 2 types). NC verification hooks validate feed and speed against machine limits.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Cycle time schemas: >= 20 parameters with estimation fields
NC verification schemas: >= 30 parameters with feed/speed limit hooks
nightSHIFT schemas: >= 20 parameters with pre-batch validation hook
Report schemas: >= 15 parameters
Feed/speed limit hook validates against MachineRegistry spindle/feed limits
Pre-batch validation hook ensures all operations calculated before batch submit

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 240 simulation schemas | ✓ collision HARD BLOCK | ✓ travel limit + feed/speed hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

units.title: NC Output + Post-Processor Config Schemas — ~250 parameters
